newsitem.title: GERMANY: New Italian carrier Azzurra Air takes to the air.
newsitem.headline: New Italian carrier Azzurra Air takes to the air.

text.p: Newly-founded regional Italian airline Azzurra Air has launched operations with flights to Germany, Britain, France as well as domestic services.
The carrier has bought two Avro-Jets RJ85 from Aero International (Regional) to run operations, an Aero International statement said.
Azzurra Air started twice-daily from Bergamo to Rome, Munich, London City airport and Paris Charles de Gaulle airports on December 10.
The airline, in which Air Malta holds a 48 percent stake, can carry up to 100 passengers per flight and will take delivery of a third Avro-Jet next April, the statement added.

Aero International senior vice-president sales and marketing, Jeff Marsch, said the contract was the first delivery of an Avro-Jet to Italy. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
